notes: Manual assertions (submit states, explains decisions, CHANGES.md, nav structure, aria-current, focus) pass for BOTH configs: the baseline model is already strong, so these do not discriminate.
Discriminating signals: UXL scanner checks (mobile tap targets, visible focus, input types/autocomplete) and law-cited reasoning (with_skill 3/3 vs without_skill 0/3).
Static/runtime heuristic scores: with_skill 100/100 on every deliverable; without_skill 89-94 (lint) and 89-100 (audit).
Blind qualitative comparison (eval 3, AppShell): grader would ship the with_skill design; baseline had an SSR hydration risk and 36px sidebar rows on touch tablets.
Cost: with_skill used ~2x tokens and ~1.8x wall time, mostly on verification (before/after scans, custom flow tests, a separate case-file document). Iteration 2 trims mandated overhead.
Scanner false positives found during grading (grouped nav, repeated CTA, :focus-within rings, honeypots, postcodes) were fixed and regression-tested before final grading.
